# Demo B tour proof and replay lag current dock contracts

## Context

The focused external-Brain evidence work on #17844 now reaches Demo B's cross-window proof. `DemoBPerspectivesNL` retains the original pane but reads mount count 3 where its endpoint expects 2. An oracle-preserving cold-gesture diagnostic at Engine `bfd1d262b2` captured the actual executor receipt:

| Stage | Pane mount delta |
| --- | ---: |
| Source → live vessel | 1 |
| Vessel → target header proxy | 0 |
| Final target document | 1 |
| Total | 2 |

The target embodiment is header=true, ownsPane=false, settled=true and visible=true. Same-instance, non-reset frames, source removal, target placement, one transfer and source-drop suppression all pass. The receipt rejects only “target proxy added exactly one mount” and “vessel, proxy and final target each mounted once”.

## The Problem

The example's post-transfer oracle still requires the old pane-owning proxy (proxy +1, total +3). The accepted header-only proxy carries no pane mount. This rejects a valid committed transfer and prevents the perspective tour from continuing. The cold cross-window witness mirrors those stale numbers; the perspective endpoint still assumes only one transfer mount.

## The Architectural Reality

- `DemoBWorkspace#commitCrossWindowTransfer` already captures pre-gesture, settled vessel, settled proxy and final target counters; its existing deltas isolate every stage.
- `VesselEmbodiment`'s header branch renders a header and never stages the pane. Its snapshot exposes header, ownership, settlement, visibility and window identity.
- `DemoBCrossWindowDragNL.spec.mjs`'s cold arm reads the complete receipt; its round-trip arm already expects header-only ownership.
- `DemoBPerspectivesNL.spec.mjs` owns the paced tour and deterministic no-pause replay.

Design authority: ADR 0029 §2.8.6 says “the live pane stays in the parked vessel until the drop”; merged PR `#19254` implemented that contract. The current stage receipt matches it.

## The Fix

Align the example-owned proof and its two dependent E2E witnesses with the header-only path. Explicitly prove a settled visible header proxy for the correct item and target that does not own the pane, then require stage deltas 1/0/1 and total 2. Retain single-commit/drop suppression, document ownership, identity and frame checks. The perspective endpoint must count the vessel and final-target mounts; the tour and replay must then finish. Align the full Group workspace-key set and optional catalog-reference expectations with ADR 0029 and the landed placement/reference changes; correct the stale example comments. The headed-only physical adapter must not compete with headless native park/retirement.

The resumed full journey exposed two further causal gaps. Demo B starts asynchronous surface cues from observational beat events without supplying TourRunner's existing stepSettlement callback, so zero-pause restore can overtake reattach. Wire the current cue outcome and projection into that callback. A sanctioned Main delta trace then showed ancestor update 363 and toolbar update 364 each insert the same new header id, while worker/VDOM membership is unique; the DOM duplicate persists for five seconds.

The attempted Reconciler commit-suppression repair did not remove the duplicate and was discarded. A subsequent pre-send probe found an emitted deep host without in-flight protection. Generic renderer prerequisite #19467 owns that defect; this leaf retains the strict consistency check and a later direct toolbar-write control. Its runtime scope remains the two existing example modules and two E2E witnesses. The measured cue/receipt repair also updates the existing DemoBWorkspace size-guard baseline from 2,503 to 2,514 code lines; the PR supplies the guard-required per-path growth rationale.

Prescription checked: host proof/cue ordering belong in DemoBWorkspace. The generic renderer's emitted-root protection belongs to prerequisite #19467 and remains outside this leaf.

Structure map: N/A — existing Body example/witness restoration; no new modules or Agent OS surface.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Host requires a settled, visible header-only proxy for the expected item and target, with ownsPane=false.
- [ ] Host proof requires vessel +1, proxy +0, target +1, total +2, retaining every other commit, ownership, suppression, identity and frame check.
- [ ] Cold cross-window witness asserts that same stage/embodiment contract; round-trip and cancellation arms remain verified.
- [ ] Paced perspective tour and deterministic no-pause replay finish with the original counter, expected mounts, advancing frames, complete registered Group capture, optional-reference metadata and the existing changed-topology restore outcome.
- [ ] Focus-header worker, VDOM and DOM membership are unique after projection and a subsequent toolbar write; the duplicate-birth red control remains recorded.
- [ ] Both complete existing spec files pass with the external Brain runtime; the unchanged host/oracle receipt remains the red control.
- [ ] A focused receipt is linked to #17844; full-battery and headed/native acceptance are not certified by this leaf.

## Out of Scope

Generic Main/VDOM lifecycle changes, weaker settlement, new tour paths, placement history repair, full-battery or headed acceptance.

## Avoided Traps

Do not change only the scalar endpoint: the host receipt itself aborts the tour. No pane staging added to justify old counts, no swallowed refusal, no new helper.
